ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the efforts of the state's Medicaid Fraud Control Unit to prevent and investigate fraud.
questions: What is the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How effective is the state's Medicaid Fraud Control Unit in preventing and investigating fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant fraud and waste in Minnesota's Medicaid program. By analyzing data and conducting interviews with officials and experts, we can shed light on the scope of the problem and the efforts to address it.
